  • How does that impact your network security?
  • How can that telemetry data be intercepted and used by hackers to probe your internal network?

Other questions:

  • Can this telemetry data be abused as an internal DoS attack within your enterprise.
  • Can this telemetry data go berserk when when a Microsoft router that accepts this telemetry data be misconfigurated?
  • Can hackers use fake telemetry data to hack Microsoft servers?
  • Can hackers piggy back a worm onto the telemetry data to attack the Microsoft cloud?
